media.title: Hans Albers in Berlin, 1924
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the actor Hans Albers in a coat and hat on a Berlin street, 1924.
media.publicCaption: Hans Albers photographed walking Unter den Linden in Berlin, 1924 — nine years before he took the lead in Heut' kommt's drauf an, the 1933 comedy for which Kaper and Jurmann wrote the songs.
media.publicCreditLine: Bundesarchiv, Bild 102-00586A / photographer unknown; CC BY-SA 3.0 DE.
